name: Guru membuat kelas baru lalu siswa masuk dengan kode (DB)

planSteps.description: Fill the Email input with hikmal@ruangbelajar.id and the Password input with demo1234, then click the submit button 'Masuk ke dashboard'
Verify the URL becomes /guru/dashboard and the button '+ Buat kelas baru' is visible in the 'Mulai ruang baru' panel
Click the button '+ Buat kelas baru' (opens a dialog)
Verify the dialog appears with the heading 'Buat kelas baru.' and contains a 'Nama kelas' input and a 'Jenjang' select
Fill the 'Nama kelas' input with 'Kelas E2E Semester Genap' and leave Jenjang as Paket B, then click the submit button '+ Buat kelas baru' in the dialog
Verify the success view shows 'Kelas berhasil dibuat' and a prominent 6-character access code (letters/numbers). Remember this access code
Click the 'Selesai' button to close the dialog
Navigate to /siswa/masuk and enter the remembered access code plus the student name 'Siswa E2E'
Verify the student successfully enters the class and the class dashboard shows the class name 'Kelas E2E Semester Genap'
